name: 字形游乐场 / Type Playground
summary: Playful editorial typography in which words and tangible graphic actors change scale, collide, soften and form relationships according to the current content.
principles: Treat important words as actors with weight, intention and a clear visual focus.
Build contrast between a bold, immediate gesture and a quieter place to read.
typography: Prefer expressive, substantial letterforms; mix sizes and densities when the content calls for it.
Allow a key glyph to become an object without losing the relationship to its surrounding phrase.
composition: Use generous negative space, deliberate asymmetry and strong differences in scale.
Change the framing inside a lyric phrase when a new verb, stress or relationship deserves it; alternate wide, close and off-center views.
Let position, enclosure, distance and overlap express relationships; avoid presenting every phrase on a centered card.
color: Use tactile light and dark fields with a few purposeful, vivid actor colors; select the actual palette for each song.
motion: Combine anticipation, acceleration, impact, overshoot and readable holds.
Use fast, fluid camera pushes, diagonal traversals and scale changes to redirect attention; settle the important word long enough to read.
Carry an actor or shape through a composition switch so speed retains a visible cause and direction.
Use physical transformations such as pressure, opening, falling and reaching only where the new words justify them.
rhythm: Use supplied lyric/subphrase timing and real musical accents to place changes; distinguish authored editorial cues from vocal alignment.
Vary the length of a transition and the following hold; neither a fixed cut interval nor constant motion defines energy.
semantics: Translate a lyric's verbs and relationships into spatial or material changes.
Reinterpret the principle for each song instead of mapping words to a finite library of fixed shots.
transitions: Carry a contour, actor, color responsibility or movement into the next thought when that connection is meaningful.
avoid: A mandatory color palette, font list or shot count
One centered layout repeated for every lyric line
Continuous bouncing that removes readable holds
Copying a source video's lyrics, footage or shot timings

limitations: This portable profile describes authored preferences and makes no claim to analyze a reference video.
